Earlier numerical/runtime and unrelated UI rows are retained, not claimed to have been rerun. Chain playback and pointer interaction are separately rechecked.

/* SVG circles alone do not prevent Chromium from cancelling a touch drag. */
[data-chain-scene] svg,[data-mechanics-scene] svg{touch-action:none}
dependencyRevalidations.scope: Only touch-action on two SVG scene containers changes. All JavaScript, mathematical functions, SVG geometry, control values, timers, CSV and other CSS are byte-identical. Prior desktop/rendering/unrelated touch observations are retained with their original dates; they were not rerun by this revalidation. The 13 affected models have a separate real Chromium touch regression report (26 mobile/tablet cases).
